newsitem.title: USA: Sybron International Corp Q2 net climbs.
newsitem.headline: Sybron International Corp Q2 net climbs.

text.p: Sybron International Corp said margin improvements and cost reductions helped the company post record earnings and sales in the second quarter ended March 31.
The company reported net income of $20.8 million, or $0.43 a share, versus $10.5 million, or $0.35 a share before a restructuring charge, in the same period last year.
Sybron said the $6.1 million charge reduced last year's results by $0.13 a share to a total of $0.22 a share.
Sales in the period climbed to $185.9 million from $170.9 million in the same period a year ago, Sybron said.
The company said it remains active in pursuing acquisitions, having bought five companies since February.
Sybron makes and markets laboratory and dental supply products worldwide.
Its shares closed up 1/8 Monday at 29.
